scoring: Passing: 1 point per 25 yards, 4 per touchdown, -1 per interception
Rushing and receiving: 1 point per 10 yards, 6 per touchdown, 1 per catch
+3 at 300 passing yards, 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards (priced at their odds: the chance of reaching the mark × 3)
Defense: sack 1, interception 2, fumble recovery 2, touchdown 6, safety 2, blocked kick 2; points allowed 0 → 10, 1–6 → 7, 7–13 → 4, 14–20 → 1, 21–27 → 0, 28–34 → −1, 35+ → −4
